title: CryoFac
blurb: A liquid-nitrogen ice-cream night I help run for MIT Campus Preview Weekend — ~50 gallons of base frozen on the spot into 15+ flavors amid clouds of nitrogen vapor.
description: CryoFac is the liquid-nitrogen ice-cream station I help organize for MIT's Campus Preview Weekend, the spring event that welcomes newly admitted students to campus.

With other East Campus residents, we freeze roughly 50 gallons of base on the spot into 15+ flavors — from classics to black sesame and coconut green tea — while plumes of nitrogen vapor roll across the table. It's part chemistry demo, part welcome party, and a great excuse to talk to prospective students about life at MIT.
